scoring.per_question_correctness: 1 only if all required perimeter/identifier points are correct and no failure condition occurs; otherwise 0.
scoring.scope_and_caveat: 1 if the answer explicitly labels the selected perimeter and all material ambiguity/date/source-period caveats; otherwise 0.
scoring.false_aggregation: 1 if the answer silently combines excluded, affiliated, branded, or non-additive entities/perimeters; otherwise 0.
scoring.provenance_coverage: number of gold-required factual claims supported by a primary-source URL divided by required factual claims; clarification-only answers receive full credit when clarification is the gold answer and the ambiguity source is cited.
